item.title: X15 X15Pro TWS Bluetooth Wireless Gaming Earphones with Low Latency and Battery level display
item.description:
❤️ Warranty policy: In order to give back to new and old customers, as long as you buy the product and release five-star praise, you can enjoy the one-year warranty period of our store (as long as the product is defective, we can give the product refund or replacement) If your order is completed and cannot be refunded on the shopee platform, you can consult customer service.❤️

Looking for high-quality wireless gaming earphones with low latency and a battery level display? Look no further than the X15/X15Pro Bluetooth Gaming Earphones! These earphones offer:

Button functions:
1.Power on: Open the charging case to make the earbuds boot up and start pairing, or hold Touch Button for 3 seconds.
2.Power off： Put the earbuds into the charging case, or hold Touch Button for 5 seconds.
3.Play/Pause: lap Switch Button on an earbud to pause/continue to play the current music being played.
4.Answer a call/Hang up: Tap louch Button on an earbud to answer the call when the phone is ringing, or to hang up the phone.
5.Reject a call: Hold Touch Button for 1 second to reject a phone call.
6.Previous: Quick-tap Touch Button A 3 times
7.Next: Quick-tap Touch Button B 3 times
8.Volume +: Quick-tap Ibuch Button A 2 times
9.Volume Quick-tap Touch Button B 2 times
10.Use Siri: Press and hold Tbuch Button for 1.5 seconds when the earbuds are connected to the phone.
11.Quick-tap the button 4 times to switch between Game Mode and Music Mode when the earbuds are connected to the phone.

Merit:
・Low latency technology for a high-quality gaming experience
・Wireless connectivity for up to 10 meters
・Battery level display for easy monitoring
・Compatible with smartphones and PC gaming

With clear and high-quality audio, these earp3hones are the perfect choice for gamers who demand the best. So why wait? Get your X15/X15Pro Bluetooth Gaming Earphones today and take your gaming to the next level!
